seats.text:
I implemented `format` in `format.ts`, and a quick spot check gave the results the README describes.

It does all rounding on the exact binary value of the double using `BigInt`, with ties going to the even digit. That covers `%.2f` of 2.675 giving `2.67` and `%.0f` of 0.5 and 2.5 giving `0` and `2`.

I ran only a handful of cases, not a full test suite. They covered:
- `f`, `e`, `g` and `#g`
- zero padding
- `+d`
- `#o` and `#x`
- `%.0d` of 0
- `s` and `c` padding
- `-0` and `Infinity`

I didn't try `NaN`, bigint arguments, `%%`, subnormals or very large widths and precisions. I also didn't check `%E` or `%G` on `Infinity` or `NaN`. `%G` was only checked on a normal value (`1E-10`).
